entities.summary: Giuseppe Salvago Raggi was an Italian diplomat, born in Genoa. He was the son of Paris Maria Salvago and Violante Raggi. After his mother's death in 1867, he acquired Raggi as his second surname in January 1881, "in memory of his mother". His father, a landowner with a Catholic-liberal orientation, was a deputy in the Tenth Legislature of the Kingdom of Italy.
